title: US overdose deaths involving synthetic opioids (mainly illicit fentanyl)

source.name: Drug overdose deaths involving synthetic opioids, National Vital Statistics System
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: Deaths involving synthetic opioids other than methadone (overwhelmingly illicit fentanyl) rose from about 3,105 in 2013 to over 70,600 in 2021, as illicit fentanyl increasingly replaced the prescription-opioid supply.
